summary_1line: Sagara’s sons dig through the earth seeking the stolen horse, accuse sage Kapila, and are instantly burned to ashes by his divine wrath.

image_candidates.scene_text: The furious sons of Sagara rush at the meditating sage Kapila beside the grazing sacrificial horse, raising rocks and trees as weapons.
Kapila opens his eyes and utters a thunderous sound as the charging princes are instantly reduced to heaps of ash around him.
Deep beneath the earth, the princes stand in awe before the colossal elephant Virupaksha supporting a quarter of the world.
